name: Last Days of the Universe
source:
A super-massive black-hole is continously expanding in the center of a universe on the verge of collapse. Entire civilizations have been destroyed, others have escaped... for a while. No one is safe.

You are the leader of a world facing obliteration. Will you find a way to escape the impending doom?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/LastDays]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
一个濒临崩溃的宇宙中，超大质量黑洞在中心不断膨胀。整个文明接连毁灭，其他文明也只能暂时逃亡。没有人安全。

你是一个即将被湮灭世界的领袖。你能找到逃离末日的方法吗？

[来源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/LastDays]Patreon[/url]]
